display.purpose: The page title (h1). At most 50rem wide.

headline.purpose: Section headings (h2) and the title of a tile.

title.purpose: Sub-headings (h3), the heading of a note box, the site name in the header and the text of a button.

lead.purpose: The intro paragraph directly below the page title.

body.purpose: Running text and the menu. A line is at most 42.5rem wide.

label.purpose: The language names in the header and the footer. The smallest text on the site.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Length of every transition: colour, background, underline thickness, the tile arrow and the skip link.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Curve of every transition. Transitions run only when the device does not ask for less movement.

breakpoints.name: menu-two-columns
breakpoints.purpose: Below this window width the menu becomes a table of two columns.

sizes.name: measure
sizes.purpose: Widest a line of running text gets, about 70 characters.

sizes.name: gutter
sizes.purpose: Free space left and right of the content.

sizes.name: target
sizes.purpose: Smallest height of something to click or tap.

sizes.name: entry-indent
sizes.purpose: How far the text of a tile or note box stands in from its heading.

sizes.name: rule-thin
sizes.purpose: Footer line, tile border, note box border, divider in the text.

sizes.name: rule-thick
sizes.purpose: Line below the header, button border, border of the current-page tab.

sizes.name: focus-width
sizes.purpose: Width of the keyboard focus ring. It stands 3px away from the element.

colorSchemes.note: Token names ending in -dark replace their light partner under prefers-color-scheme: dark. The flag colours are the same in both versions.

narrative.overview:
The site looks like a page of a printed dictionary. Serif text stands on near-white paper. Thin ink lines divide the page. Headings are bold, like the headwords of a dictionary. A visitor finds their program the way they find a word: by its bold name at the left edge.

The page is calm and large. The text is big, the buttons are big, and one line of text is never longer than about 70 characters. There are no shadows, no gradients as decoration and no rounded cards. The three flag colours appear as a stripe across the top of every page. Below the stripe they are accents only.

The site has no JavaScript and loads no font files. Every effect is plain CSS. The dark version follows the setting of the device.
keyCharacteristics: One serif typeface from the device, for everything.
Near-white paper and blue-black ink, with ink lines of 1px and 2px.
A flag stripe of 8px (0.5rem) across the top of every page.
Blue marks what can be clicked. Gold marks a note.
The current page hangs from the header line as a dark tab, like the thumb index of a dictionary.
In a tile and in a note box the heading stands at the left and the text below it is indented, like a dictionary entry.

rules.name: The Blue Means Click Rule
rules.body: Below the flag stripe, blue marks only what a visitor can click: links, buttons and the focus ring around them in the light version. Text that is not a link is never blue.

rules.name: The Gold Is Ground Rule
rules.body: Gold is a background or a ring, never text. It appears as the note box ground, as the ground of selected text, as the dark focus ring and in the stripe.

rules.name: The Two Versions Rule
rules.body: Every colour that has a job has a light and a dark value. A new colour needs both, and both must meet WCAG AA for the text on it.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: There is one font stack and two weights: 400 for text and 700 for headings, buttons and emphasis. No second typeface.

rules.name: The Large Text Rule
rules.body: No text is smaller than 1.0625rem (17px at the usual browser setting). Body text is at least 1.125rem (18px).

rules.name: The Upright Is Here Rule
rules.body: In the language switcher the other languages are italic and underlined. The language of the page is upright, bold and not underlined. This is the only use of italics in the layout.

rules.name: The Left Edge Rule
rules.body: Icon, site name, menu, page title and text all start at the same left edge. Nothing is centred.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Running text is never wider than 42.5rem. Only a group of tiles, and a note box next to one, use the full width of the column.

rules.name: The Ink Line Rule
rules.body: Parts of the page are divided by lines and borders, never by shadows.

dos: Do use the custom properties at the top of `website/src/styles/global.css` for every colour, type size and spacing value.
Do give a new colour a light and a dark value, and check that both meet WCAG AA.
Do start headings and text at the left edge of the column, and keep running text within 42.5rem.
Do make everything that can be clicked at least 3rem high.
Do underline links. An underline is how a visitor sees that words can be clicked.
Do give pointer hover and keyboard focus the same feedback.
Do put every transition inside the `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` block.
Do use the indented entry shape for new boxes: heading at the left, text indented by 1.4em.
donts: Don't use gold as a text colour.
Don't use blue for text or boxes that cannot be clicked.
Don't use red outside the flag stripe and the icon.
Don't add shadows, larger corner radii or decorative gradients.
Don't add a second typeface or load a font file.
Don't add JavaScript, `<style>` blocks in components or `style` attributes. All styles are in the one stylesheet.
